name: rbac-backend
description: Role-Based Admin Backend (Node.js, Express, PostgreSQL, Sequelize)

scripts.db:reset: npm run db:migrate:undo:all && npm run db:migrate && npm run db:seed
scripts.test:postman: newman run postman/collections/v1-admin.postman_collection.json -e postman/environments/local.postman_environment.json --bail && newman run postman/collections/v1-user.postman_collection.json -e postman/environments/local.postman_environment.json --bail && newman run postman/collections/v1-subadmin.postman_collection.json -e postman/environments/local.postman_environment.json --bail
